320	No matter how much a person tries to imagine, it is beyond the grasp of
321	human
322	beings. This is what is called "all the life of this world." "Better is one hour
323	of contentment of spirit in the World to Come than all the life of this world."
324	"Contentment of spirit" means you haven't yet entered Gan Eden, you only catch a little
325	of the fragrance from outside, of what happens there
326	inside. In Jerusalem there is the Angel bakery. Whoever walks
327	by the bakery usually walks more slowly.
328	How pleasant it is there. That is called contentment of spirit. "Better is one hour
329	of contentment of spirit in the World to Come than all the life of this world."
330	What is the logic? At first glance it sounds a bit exaggerated. What is
331	the logic? The logic is simple: matter, as is known, is
332	a kind of imagination. We see matter as something
333	real because that is what we perceive with our eyes. But
334	in truth, matter is a kind of imagination.
335	Even in science they are beginning to understand this. They know
336	that all matter is made of atoms, which are tiny particles
337	that are all packed one next to
338	the other. On the point of a pin, how many atoms are there at the very
339	tip? How many atoms are there? You have to write the number
340	three and then 15 zeros. That is the number of atoms
341	on the point of a pin. And what is each atom made of?
342	An inner nucleus and electrons that spin around it
343	at speed, and then they create the illusion of a shell. Like
344	a fan: it has blades, but when it spins
345	fast you see a disc. The disc is an illusion. It
346	looks like a solid, but it is not solid, it is only
347	the speed. So electrons moving at speed
348	create the illusion of a shell, and when there are billions
349	upon billions of them packed together, we see
350	matter. Physicists claim: what would happen if
351	the electrons stopped
352	their motion? What would happen? The whole universe
353	would disappear. They claim that the real matter of the entire
354	planet Earth could fit in a matchbox. That is the
355	real matter that exists. All the rest is imagination. It is a kind
356	of... Since matter is imagination, the Kabbalists say
357	that the pleasures we enjoy are also a kind of
358	imagination. In the material world, when a person enjoys, it is a kind of
359	imagination, but he enjoys because it suits matter.
